verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents a REST API with per-resource endpoints (invoices, expenses, payments, journal entries), search and paging, webhooks, and automated bank reconciliation. None of it describes a bulk or batch operation that acts on many items at once. Paging and list queries, single-record create endpoints, and the SDK are building blocks or adjacent features, not a documented bulk-operation capability, so the axis applies but has no evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
